semiconductor_relevance: High — The company manufactures consumable spare parts for semiconductor equipment, specifically for Ion Implanters.
summary: Value Engineering specializes in the production of consumable spare parts for semiconductor equipment, focusing on the Arc-Chamber, a critical component of the Ion Source Assembly in Ion Implanters. The company has grown significantly by localizing products and investing in research and development to meet the semiconductor industry's evolving needs.
